Fact.Name: QDCG line 2
Fact.Description: QDCG Tax Worksheet—Line 16 (Form 1040 instr. (2025) p.38) line 2: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 3a" (income /qualifiedDividends: Form 1099-DIV box 1b plus Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 2b, Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) box 6b, and Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) box 5b, in whole dollars). Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) (2025) page 2 reports box 2b on line 3a. Partner's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) (2025), PDF p. 15, Box 6b, and Shareholder's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) (2025), PDF p. 7, Box 5b, report qualified dividends on line 3a. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(11); 702(a)(5); 1366(b).

Fact.Name: QDCG line 3
Fact.Description: QDCG Tax Worksheet—Line 16 (Form 1040 instr. (2025) p.38) line 3: "Are you filing Schedule D? Yes. Enter the smaller of line 15 or line 16 of Schedule D. If either line 15 or line 16 is blank or a loss, enter -0-. No. Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a." Schedule D is filed when scheduleD /requiresScheduleD; otherwise line 7a is $0 or, under line 7a Exception 1, the capital gain distributions (income /capitalGainsOrLosses, dividends /capitalGainDistributionsWithoutScheduleD). Before you begin, item 3: "If you don't have to file Schedule D and you received capital gain distributions, be sure you checked the box on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7b" (income /capitalGainsScheduleDNotRequired). IRC §1(h)(11), §1222(11).

Fact.Name: Uses QDCG Tax Worksheet
Fact.Description: Form 1040 instr. (2025) https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040gi.pdf p. 36, Line 16, Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet: use it "if you don't have to use the Schedule D Tax Worksheet and if any of the following applies. • You reported qualified dividends on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 3a. • You don't have to file Schedule D and you reported capital gain distributions on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a. • You are filing Schedule D, and Schedule D, lines 15 and 16, are both more than zero." Each bullet makes worksheet line 4 (lines 2 + 3) more than $0, so this is line 4 > 0, and the Schedule D Tax Worksheet does not apply. 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/i1040sd--dft.pdf, Schedule D Tax Worksheet: use that worksheet, not this one, when line 18 or line 19 of Schedule D is more than zero and lines 15 and 16 are gains, or Form 4952 line 4g has an amount. Line 18 and Form 4952 still stop. Line 19 is /usesScheduleDTaxWorksheet. Form 2555 is out of scope.

Fact.Name: Tentative tax from taxable income
Fact.Description: Tax as reported on Form 1040 line 16. Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 47 when Schedule D line 19 is more than zero and lines 15 and 16 are both gains (2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/i1040sd--dft.pdf). Otherwise QDCG Tax Worksheet—Line 16 (Form 1040 instr. (2025) p.38) line 25 when it applies, otherwise Tax Table / Tax Computation Worksheet on line 15 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §4.01 pp.10–12 rates).

Fact.Name: Rounded QDCG worksheet line 5
Fact.Description: Income less than $100,000 uses the tax tables from the Instructions for Form 1040. This fact selects the "midpoint" that corresponds to each entry in the tax tables, for use in calculating tenative tax.

Fact.Name: QDCG Tax Worksheet line 22
Fact.Description: QDCG Tax Worksheet (Form 1040 instr. (2025) p.38) line 22: "Figure the tax on the amount on line 5" using the Tax Table / Tax Computation Worksheet. Same §1(j)(2) tables as /taxOnTaxableIncomeRegularRates (generated copy, input swapped to line 5).Rev Proc .01 Tax Rate Tables §1(j)(2)(A|B|C|D)TODO: Replace Any/Equal with Include

Fact.Name: Uses the Schedule D Tax Worksheet
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/i1040sd--dft.pdf, Schedule D Tax Worksheet: "Complete this worksheet only if line 18 or line 19 of Schedule D is more than zero and lines 15 and 16 of Schedule D are gains or if you file Form 4952 and you have an amount on line 4g, even if you don't need to file Schedule D. Otherwise, complete the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet". Line 18 stays zero because section 1202 gain and collectibles still stop. Form 4952 still stops, so line 4g never applies. Schedule D line 19 is entered only when lines 15 and 16 are both gains, so line 19 more than zero is the whole gate. The total of Form 1099-DIV box 2b is tested first so this fact is complete and false, and the QDCG worksheet is unchanged, when box 2b is $0 even if Schedule D is still incomplete. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(E).

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 1
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 1: taxable income from Form 1040 line 15. Form 2555 is not collected.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 2
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 2: qualified dividends from Form 1040 line 3a.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 6
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 3 through 6. Lines 3 and 4 are Form 4952 lines 4g and 4e, both $0 because Form 4952 stops the return. Line 5 is line 3 minus line 4, floored at zero, so $0. Line 6 is line 2 minus line 5, floored at zero: qualified dividends.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 7
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 7: the smaller of Schedule D line 15 or line 16. The worksheet is used only when both are gains. A loss or zero is entered as zero so it is not subtracted as a negative.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 9
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 8 and 9. Line 8 is the smaller of Form 4952 lines 4g and 4e, which is $0. Line 9 is line 7 minus line 8, floored at zero.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 10
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 10: add lines 6 and 9.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 11
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 11: add Schedule D lines 18 and 19. Line 18 is $0 because section 1202 gain and collectibles still stop.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 12
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 12: the smaller of line 9 or line 11.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 13
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 13: subtract line 12 from line 10. This is the gain taxed at 0%, 15%, or 20%. Form 6251 line 13 uses this amount when this worksheet applies.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 14
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 14: subtract line 13 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0-. Form 6251 line 20 uses this amount when this worksheet applies.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 15
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 15: the 0% maximum. The 2026 draft prints the 2025 amounts ($48,350, $96,700, and $64,750). TY2026 uses Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.03 via /capGainsZeroRateAmount, the same amounts the QDCG worksheet uses.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 16
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 16: the smaller of line 1 or line 15.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 17
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 17: the smaller of line 14 or line 16.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 18
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 18: subtract line 10 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0-.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 19
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 19: the smaller of line 1 or the top of the 24% ordinary bracket. The 2026 draft prints the 2025 amounts ($197,300 and $394,600). TY2026 uses Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.01 via /ordinaryIncome25PercentThreshold. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(E) taxes unrecaptured section 1250 gain at a maximum of 25%, so ordinary income above this threshold is what makes the 25% slice larger than the ordinary rate.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 20
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 20: the smaller of line 14 or line 19.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 21
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 21: the larger of line 18 or line 20. Form 6251 line 27 uses this amount when this worksheet applies. Line 44 figures the tax on this amount.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 22
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 22: subtract line 17 from line 16. This amount is taxed at 0%.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 23
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 23: the smaller of line 1 or line 13. Skipped, and not used below, when line 1 equals line 16.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 25
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 24 and 25. Line 24 is line 22. Line 25 is line 23 minus line 24, floored at zero.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 26
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 26: the 15% maximum. The 2026 draft prints the 2025 amounts ($533,400, $300,000, $600,050, and $566,700). TY2026 uses Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.03 via /capGains15RateAmount.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 27
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 27: the smaller of line 1 or line 26.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 28
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 28: add lines 21 and 22.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 29
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 29: subtract line 28 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 30
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 30: the smaller of line 25 or line 29.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 31
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 31: multiply line 30 by 15% (0.15). If line 1 and line 16 are the same, skip lines 23 through 43, so this line is zero. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(C).

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 32
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 32: add lines 24 and 30. Line 24 is line 22.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 33
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 33: subtract line 32 from line 23. If zero or less, enter -0-.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 34
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 34: multiply line 33 by 20% (0.20). Zero when lines 23 through 43 are skipped (line 1 equals line 16) or lines 33 through 43 are skipped (line 1 equals line 32). 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(D).

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 35
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 35: the smaller of line 9 or Schedule D line 19.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 39
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 36 through 39. Line 36 is line 10 plus line 21. Line 37 is line 1. Line 38 is line 36 minus line 37, floored at zero. Line 39 is line 35 minus line 38, floored at zero. This is the unrecaptured section 1250 gain taxed at 25%.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 40
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 40: multiply line 39 by 25% (0.25). Zero when lines 23 through 43 or lines 33 through 43 are skipped, or when Schedule D line 19 is zero or blank (skip lines 35 through 40). 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(E) and 1(h)(6).

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 43
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 41 through 43 multiply the 28% rate gain by 28%. Schedule D line 18 is zero because section 1202 gain and collectibles still stop, so those lines are skipped and this line is zero. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(F).

Fact.Name: Rounded Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 21
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 44 uses the Tax Table when line 21 is less than $100,000. This fact selects the midpoint of the Tax Table row, the same way /qdcgRoundedLine5 does for QDCG line 5. Generated copy; the input is line 21.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 44
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/i1040sd--dft.pdf, Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 44: figure the tax on line 21. Tax Table under $100,000; Tax Computation Worksheet at $100,000 or more. Same 26 U.S.C. 1(j)(2) tables as /qdcgLine22 (generated copy, input swapped to line 21). Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.01.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 45
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 45: add lines 31, 34, 40, 43, and 44.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 46
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 46: the tax on line 1. Tax Table under $100,000; Tax Computation Worksheet at $100,000 or more. Same amount as /taxOnTaxableIncomeRegularRates.

Fact.Name: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 47
Fact.Description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 47: the smaller of line 45 or line 46. This is Form 1040 line 16 when /usesScheduleDTaxWorksheet is true. Whole dollars.
